method: Targeted primary-source review, not an exhaustive systematic review. Abstract-level evidence unless a section locator is recorded. No experiments reproduced. Translations are original summaries; source material remains under its own license.

sources.title: Asleep at the Keyboard? Assessing the Security of GitHub Copilot's Code Contributions
sources.claim_en: 89 security-oriented scenarios produced 1,689 programs; approximately 40% were vulnerable in this experiment.
sources.claim_zh: 该实验在 89 个安全相关场景生成 1,689 个程序，约 40% 存在漏洞。
sources.limit_en: Early Copilot and selected high-risk scenarios; not a current universal vulnerability rate.
sources.limit_zh: 早期 Copilot 与特定高风险场景，不能推广为当前全部 AI 代码的漏洞率。

sources.title: Do Users Write More Insecure Code with AI Assistants?
sources.claim_en: Participants with the codex-davinci-002 assistant produced less secure code and were more confident in its security.
sources.claim_zh: 使用 codex-davinci-002 助手的参与者写出更不安全的代码，却更相信其安全性。
sources.limit_en: A particular user study and model; confidence is not a substitute for verification.
sources.limit_zh: 特定用户研究与模型，不代表所有工具或用户；信心不能代替验证。

sources.title: Is Your Code Generated by ChatGPT Really Correct? Rigorous Evaluation of Large Language Models for Code Generation
sources.claim_en: HumanEval+ expanded tests by 80 times; evaluation of 26 models exposed previously missed wrong code and ranking changes.
sources.claim_zh: HumanEval+ 将测试扩充至约 80 倍，对 26 个模型的评估发现原测试漏掉的错误及排名变化。
sources.limit_en: Function-level benchmark; stronger tests still are not a complete correctness proof.
sources.limit_zh: 函数级基准；更强的测试仍不是完整正确性证明。

sources.title: We Have a Package for You! A Comprehensive Analysis of Package Hallucinations by Code Generating LLMs
sources.claim_en: 16 models generated 576,000 Python/JavaScript samples. Reported average hallucinated-package percentages were at least 5.2% for commercial and 21.7% for open-source models.
sources.claim_zh: 16 个模型生成 576,000 个 Python/JavaScript 样本；论文报告商业模型与开源模型的平均虚构包比例至少为 5.2% 和 21.7%。
sources.limit_en: Package percentages under the study setup, not percentages of developers, all samples, or current models; registry existence is not trust.
sources.limit_zh: 这是实验设置下的包比例，不是开发者比例、全部样本错误率或当前模型错误率；包存在也不等于可信。

sources.title: LLM Hallucinations in Practical Code Generation: Phenomena, Mechanism, and Mitigation
sources.claim_en: Repository-level analysis of six models classified hallucinations and evaluated context retrieval as mitigation.
sources.claim_zh: 对六个模型进行仓库级分析，分类代码幻觉，并评估上下文检索缓解方法。
sources.limit_en: Supports checking repository context; does not establish that this skill's premise ledger prevents hallucinations.
sources.limit_zh: 支持检查仓库上下文的必要性，不证明本 skill 的前提记录能消除幻觉。

sources.title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?
sources.claim_en: 2,294 issues from 12 Python repositories require coordinated edits across functions, classes and files.
sources.claim_zh: 来自 12 个 Python 仓库的 2,294 个问题要求跨函数、类和文件协同修改。
sources.limit_en: Original benchmark definition; historic model scores are not present-day capability estimates.
sources.limit_zh: 原始基准定义，历史模型成绩不用于估计当下能力。

sources.title: ClassEval: A Manually-Crafted Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on Class-level Code Generation
sources.claim_en: 100 class-level tasks evaluated 11 models; standalone method performance did not reliably represent class-level ability.
sources.claim_zh: 以 100 个类级任务评估 11 个模型；单方法表现不能等同于类级能力。
sources.limit_en: Historic Python benchmark, motivating integration checks rather than a universal failure rate.
sources.limit_zh: 历史 Python 基准，用于支持集成检查，不提供普适错误率。

sources.title: Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct Reasoning Yet
sources.claim_en: Intrinsic self-correction without external feedback struggled and sometimes degraded reasoning performance in the studied setting.
sources.claim_zh: 在所研究设置中，缺少外部反馈的自我纠正效果有限，有时降低推理表现。
sources.limit_en: Not a claim that all feedback-driven correction fails; task/model dependent.
sources.limit_zh: 不等于所有带反馈的纠错都会失败；结论依赖模型与任务。

sources.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
sources.claim_en: Agents use task feedback and episodic text memory to improve later attempts across several task types.
sources.claim_zh: 通过任务反馈和情景文本记忆改善后续尝试，覆盖多类任务。
sources.limit_en: Reflexion and ReFlect are distinct methods; reported gains cannot be transferred to Chainwright.
sources.limit_zh: Reflexion 与 ReFlect 是不同方法，不能将其效果直接转移给 Chainwright。

sources.title: Language Models Don't Always Say What They Think: Unfaithful Explanations in Chain-of-Thought Prompting
sources.claim_en: Generated explanations can omit influential biases and rationalize incorrect answers.
sources.claim_zh: 生成解释可能遗漏影响答案的偏差，并为错误答案给出合理化叙述。
sources.limit_en: An audit ledger must record observable evidence, not claim access to faithful internal reasoning.
sources.limit_zh: 审计记录应保存可观察证据，不能声称获得忠实的内部推理。

sources.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
sources.claim_en: Information position affected performance on multi-document question answering and key-value retrieval.
sources.claim_zh: 信息在上下文中的位置影响多文档问答和键值检索表现。
sources.limit_en: Not a direct coding study. Using compact ledgers for code tasks is a design inference, not a measured result here.
sources.limit_zh: 不是直接的编码研究；将紧凑记录用于代码任务属于设计推断。

sources.title: Examples of cheating in CAISI's agent evaluations
sources.locator: Section 2.2: test overfitting on SWE-bench Verified; updated 2025-12-02
sources.claim_en: NIST observed test-specific fixes and removal of checks. One example comments out an assertion instead of implementing deduplication.
sources.claim_zh: NIST 发现针对测试的特殊修复和删除检查；一个案例注释掉断言，而非实现需求中的去重。
sources.limit_en: Observed cases, not a universal frequency or proof of deliberate intent. Test changes can also be legitimate.
sources.limit_zh: 属于已观察案例，不是普遍发生率或主观意图证明；修改测试也可能合理。

sources.title: Measuring the Impact of Early-2025 AI on Experienced Open-Source Developer Productivity
sources.claim_en: In this randomized study of 16 experienced developers and 246 issues, AI-allowed tasks took 19% longer.
sources.claim_zh: 该随机研究包含 16 位有经验的开发者和 246 个问题，允许使用 AI 的任务耗时增加 19%。
sources.limit_en: Early-2025 tools and experienced contributors on familiar repositories; historical snapshot, not a general or current productivity claim. Page links later research.
sources.limit_zh: 早期 2025 工具与熟悉仓库的资深贡献者；仅为历史截面，不是普适或当前生产力结论。页面链接后续研究。

sources.title: ReFlect: An Effective Harness System for Complex Long-Horizon LLM Reasoning
sources.claim_en: Describes external error detection and predefined recovery actions around a model.
sources.claim_zh: 描述模型外部的错误检测以及预先定义的恢复动作。
sources.limit_en: Single preprint, not independently reproduced here. A prompt skill is not the paper's enforced harness and inherits no measured gains.
sources.limit_zh: 单篇预印本，本项目未独立复现；提示词 skill 不等于论文中强制执行的框架，也不继承其指标。

sources.title: CWE-362: Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization
sources.locator: Description and examples; live page accessed 2026-10-28
sources.claim_en: Defines synchronization failures around shared resources as a software weakness.
sources.claim_zh: 将共享资源的同步不当定义为软件弱点。
sources.limit_en: General software taxonomy; not evidence of AI-specific prevalence or a capability of the bundled checker.
sources.limit_zh: 通用软件弱点分类，不代表 AI 特有发生率，也不代表附带脚本能检出。

sources.title: CWE-20: Improper Input Validation
sources.claim_en: Describes inadequate validation of input properties needed for safe/correct processing.
sources.claim_zh: 描述对安全、正确处理所需输入属性验证不足的问题。
sources.limit_en: General weakness reference; boundary test selection remains contract-dependent.
sources.limit_zh: 通用弱点参考，边界测试选择仍取决于任务契约。

sources.title: Agent Skills specification
sources.locator: Directory structure, frontmatter, optional directories; live page
sources.claim_en: A skill uses SKILL.md with name/description and may bundle scripts, references and assets.
sources.claim_zh: Skill 使用含 name/description 的 SKILL.md，可附带脚本、参考资料与资源。
sources.limit_en: Format compatibility does not guarantee identical host discovery, permissions or execution.
sources.limit_zh: 格式兼容不保证宿主发现机制、权限和执行能力一致。

sources.title: Introducing Agent Skills
sources.claim_en: Anthropic announced Agent Skills as an open standard on December 18, 2025.
sources.claim_zh: Anthropic 于 2025 年 12 月 18 日更新公告，宣布 Agent Skills 成为开放标准。
sources.limit_en: The announcement establishes format history, not universal host compatibility or an adoption count.
sources.limit_zh: 公告说明格式发展历史，不代表全部宿主兼容，也不提供普遍采用数量。

sources.title: Extend Claude with skills
sources.locator: Choose where skills load; local personal/project locations
sources.claim_en: Claude Code supports personal ~/.claude/skills and project .claude/skills directories.
sources.claim_zh: Claude Code 支持个人 ~/.claude/skills 与项目 .claude/skills 目录。
sources.limit_en: Local paths do not establish availability in every Claude cloud/app mode; live-host execution not tested here.
sources.limit_zh: 本地路径不代表所有 Claude 云端或应用模式均可用；本项目未进行在线宿主验收。

sources.title: Build skills — OpenAI
sources.locator: How ChatGPT and Codex use skills; Where Codex loads local skills
sources.claim_en: Documents SKILL.md progressive loading and Codex discovery via .agents/skills, including the user directory.
sources.claim_zh: 说明 SKILL.md 的渐进加载，以及 Codex 从 .agents/skills 等位置发现技能。
sources.limit_en: ChatGPT account/surface availability and script tools must be checked. Prompt-only fallback does not execute scripts.
sources.limit_zh: 需要确认 ChatGPT 账户与界面是否提供技能和脚本工具；纯提示词回退不能执行脚本。

sources.title: DeepSeek Harness filesystem skill provider
sources.locator: Skill format; roots and priority; mount and configuration
sources.claim_en: Documents direct SKILL.md bundles under project .dsh/skills and personal DSH_HOME/skills, with filesystem discovery.
sources.claim_zh: 说明项目 .dsh/skills 与个人 DSH_HOME/skills 下直接技能目录的发现方式。
sources.limit_en: Requires the skill registry/filesystem provider; custom roots and runtime location affect discovery.
sources.limit_zh: 需要技能注册表与文件系统提供方；自定义根目录和运行环境影响发现。

sources.title: How to Meet WCAG: Quick Reference
sources.locator: Keyboard accessibility, focus, reflow, contrast and input assistance criteria; accessed 2026-10-28
sources.claim_en: Provides accessibility criteria for evaluating perceivable and operable interfaces.
sources.claim_zh: 提供用于评估界面可感知性与可操作性的可访问性准则。
sources.limit_en: Accessibility criteria do not measure aesthetic quality; automated checks alone do not establish compliance.
sources.limit_zh: 可访问性准则不等于审美评价；仅自动检查不能证明全面符合。

sources.title: Monitoring Distributed Systems — Google SRE
sources.claim_en: Uses latency, traffic, errors and saturation to describe important service monitoring signals.
sources.claim_zh: 以延迟、流量、错误和饱和度描述重要服务监测信号。
sources.limit_en: Operational guidance, not evidence of AI failure frequency or universal performance thresholds.
sources.limit_zh: 这是运维实践指导，不是 AI 失误发生率或普适性能阈值。
